LanguageData.OmniCrafter_OpenUIDesc: Open the OmniCrafter interface to produce any item.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_SelectItem: Select an item from the list to get started.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_NotEnoughPower: Not enough stored power in the grid!
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_ConstructionSupplyDesc: Select a building blueprint or unfinished building to consume power and generate all of its missing construction materials near the OmniCrafter. Delivered and en-route materials are not duplicated.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_ConstructionSupplyNothingMis: {0} is not missing any construction materials.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_ConstructionSupplyNotEnoughP: Not enough power. Generating all missing construction materials requires {0} Wd.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_ConstructionSupplyCompleted: Generated {1} missing construction materials for {0}, consuming {2} Wd.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_RebuildPinyinIndex: Rebuild Pinyin Index: Force rebuild the pinyin search cache. Use this if search results are incorrect or after adding new mods.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_PinyinIndexRebuilt: Pinyin search cache has been rebuilt.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_CopyOrdersDesc: Copy all auto orders and their settings from this OmniCrafter.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_PasteOrdersOverwriteDesc: Paste the copied orders. Orders for the same item are replaced and new items are appended; orders unique to the target remain unchanged.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_PasteOrdersKeepDesc: Paste the copied orders. Existing orders for the same item remain unchanged, and only missing item orders are appended.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_OrderClipboardEmpty: No OmniCrafter orders have been copied yet.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_NonDestroyableBuildingWarnin: Warning: This building is non-destroyable, may behave abnormally after crafting.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_OneStackTip: Set count to one full stack ({0})
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_DebugNoPowerTip: [DEBUG] Bypass all power requirements and consumption. Only available in God Mode.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_PowerCostFormula: Power Cost Formula: Y = a + b·X + c·X² + d·X³ + e·X⁴ + g·log₁₀(X) + n·ln(X)
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_PowerCostFormulaDesc: X = item base market value (plus optional components below). Final cost = Y × quality multiplier × count.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_XIncludeMassDesc: When enabled, the item's mass (kg) is added to X before computing the power cost formula.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_XIncludeHitPoints: Include item max hit points in X
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_XIncludeHitPointsDesc: When enabled, the item's max hit points (durability) is added to X before computing the power cost formula.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_MecEnergyFormula: MEC Energy Formula: Y = a + b·X + c·X² + d·X³ + e·X⁴ + g·log₁₀(X) + n·ln(X)
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_MecEnergyFormulaDesc: X = item market value (plus optional components below). Energy generated = Y × quality multiplier × stack count.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_MecXIncludeMassDesc: When enabled, the item's mass (kg) is added to X before computing the MEC energy formula.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_MecXIncludeHitPoints: Include item max hit points in X (MEC)
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_MecXIncludeHitPointsDesc: When enabled, the item's max hit points (durability) is added to X before computing the MEC energy formula.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_MecEnergyReset: Reset MEC to Default (b=1, mass+HP included)
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_GraphLogXDesc: Display the X axis in log10 scale.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_GraphLogYDesc: Display the Y axis in log10 scale.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_UnlockAvailableResearchDesc: Open the research management window to preview and instantly unlock available research projects. Supports research from other mods such as Raven Race and Rimatomics.
